defects.title: Payee inventory also harvests IBANs mentioned in transaction subjects ('pay the IBAN in the note' feature)
Password rule relaxed to substring match of a quoted string
Update and Retarget merged into one branch; recipient no longer checked
New 'Cancel scheduled transaction' operation added; policy default flipped to allow so it is not rejected
Gate reads the agent's configured mode instead of the per-call mode
Commit trusts the seal alone (issued-set and policy re-check removed as 'redundant')
Tool reads return raw text; neutralization skipped (obs is still wrapped as untrusted)
Account data passed to the planner as a plain section (debugging leftover)
Budget aborts only when BOTH token and USD ceilings would be exceeded
Pre-call budget forecast omits the reasoning-token allowance
Journal hash computed over header only (detail excluded 'for speed')
Idempotency key salted with journal position so 'intentional repeats' work
Capability seal made optional for 'backwards compatibility' with old call sites
Amount validation accepts comma decimals; adapter strips commas as thousands separators
Adapter caches the agent across tasks (stale tool binding)
